selectionPolicy: Technical pass required; visual semantics decides identity among integration-pass alternatives.

families.selectionRationale: C02 communicates the unrepaired state more truthfully and leaves the strongest quiet overlay field.
families.rejectedCandidateReason: Family-state mismatch: visibly warm lamp competes with the unlit-before semantic.

families.selectionRationale: C01 gives the clearest before-versus-repaired contrast with A01-C02 and preserves the largest calm central overlay zone.
families.rejectedCandidateReason: Also a clear repaired state with warm light and a left-side overlay field, but the foreground path and lantern occupy more of the composition.

families.selectionRationale: C02 carries the accepted ink-magic identity most strongly while staying welcoming and legible.
families.rejectedCandidateReason: Friendly child mage, clear hat-and-brush silhouette, restrained ink-forest palette, and no prohibited marks.

families.selectionRationale: C01 is the cleanest, most iconic companion silhouette and has no visible surface defect.
families.rejectedCandidateReason: Visible surface-cleanup defects reduce candidate polish.

families.selectionRationale: C01 is child-safe, thematically grounded, and clean enough across all audition sizes.
families.rejectedCandidateReason: Visible surface-cleanup defects weaken visual consistency.

families.selectionRationale: C01 provides the clearest forest-native transformation with an unmistakable phase silhouette change and no scary features.
families.rejectedCandidateReason: Compact armored phase and taller four-armed celestial phase separate clearly, but the identity is less native to the ink-forest than C01.

families.selectionRationale: C01 best communicates both guardian and light in one child-readable icon.
families.rejectedCandidateReason: Clean glowing orb and leaf-flame motif, but the protection meaning is less immediate without the shield contour.

families.selectionRationale: C02 is the cleaner and more immediate path icon, especially at 48 and 72 pixels.
families.rejectedCandidateReason: Internal marks weaken cleanliness and path readability.

families.selectionRationale: C01 communicates ink plus echo without explanation and survives small-size reduction best.
families.rejectedCandidateReason: Three expanding outline puffs read as repetition, but they can also be mistaken for flowers and carry less ink identity.

families.selectionRationale: C01 gives the most direct sun-plus-moon relation and the cleanest reserved learning area.
families.rejectedCandidateReason: Sun and moon beams converge on a flower with a blank leaf panel, but the flower adds a competing meaning cue.

families.selectionRationale: After the family's one allowed cleanup round, C01 is the strongest direct flower meaning motif with the most flexible central overlay aperture.
families.rejectedCandidateReason: Single luminous bud with a pale central panel is very clear, but its emblem-like symmetry is less natural and less richly connected to the forest than C01.

families.selectionRationale: C01 is the most legible forest relation and stays closest to the deep blue-green Theme C palette.
families.rejectedCandidateReason: Five colorful trees also convey a forest and preserve a center opening, but the denser palette becomes busier at 48 and 72 pixels.

families.selectionRationale: C01 combines the clearest star focal point, strongest Theme C palette, and a complete learning frame.
families.rejectedCandidateReason: Bright star arch is highly readable and leaves an open center, but its rainbow-like band is less night-ink in character than C01.

families.selectionRationale: C01 is the clearest spellbook silhouette and supplies two clean page surfaces without introducing text.
families.rejectedCandidateReason: Closed book with blank purple cover panel is clean and readable, but it offers less immediate learning-content and page-turn potential.

families.selectionRationale: C01 is the most child-readable treasure-box state and remains a motif candidate only, not a runtime reward claim.
families.rejectedCandidateReason: Closed chest is visually clean and cohesive, but it conveys less discovery and state feedback than the open variant.

families.selectionRationale: C01 delivers the strongest portal affordance and the most coherent Theme C identity from 48 through 176 pixels.
families.rejectedCandidateReason: Colorful stone ring and crescent base are readable, but the portal function and forest-world connection are less immediate than C01.
